title: Build a HubSpot alternative with Claude: free simple CRM spec, 27/27 checks passed
description:
Claude built a HubSpot alternative from one Markdown spec: all 27 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 91 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 8 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for a simple CRM for sales teams of 1 to 15 people and had it build the tool in four phases: the team, companies and contacts; activities, follow-ups, the Today screen and search; deals and the pipeline board; and CSV import, export and the daily digest. The core rule: every contact always has a next follow-up date that can be moved but never cleared, overdue contacts sit at the top, and logging a call always sets the next date. The gaps included owner-only buttons that were hidden while the checks expected a colleague to try them, unarchiving a contact with no stored follow-up date, and a morning digest that drifted with daylight saving on a UTC scheduler. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when HubSpot is still worth paying for.

The spec (free): https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/simple-crm
HubSpot pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/hubspot
All blueprints on GitHub: https://github.com/samclaassen/internal-tool-blueprints
Before you rely on an AI-built tool: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/guides/ai-built-tools-production-readiness

HubSpot prices: the free CRM is free for up to 2 users (and, per its product page, up to 1,000 contacts); paid seats start at $15 per seat per month on Starter (hubspot.com/pricing/crm, October 2026). Pipedrive has no free tier: Lite $14, Growth $39, Premium $59 and Ultimate $79 per seat per month, billed annually (pipedrive.com/en/pricing, October 2026).
